contractName: DanotechInc HR to Entra ID attribute contract

fields.name: EmployeeId
fields.notes: Immutable join key. Never reused, never changed, survives name changes and rehires.

fields.name: FirstName
fields.notes: Legal or preferred first name; no leading/trailing spaces.

fields.name: UserPrincipalName
fields.notes: Generated by IAM from names: accents stripped, lowercase, numeric suffix on collision. Not changed on name change without a request.

fields.name: JobTitle
fields.notes: Display only. Never used for access decisions: titles are edited for vanity, codes are not.

fields.name: JobLevel
fields.notes: L1 intern to L10 CEO. Must sit inside the job code's level range (interns exempt).

fields.name: JobFamily
fields.notes: Must match the job code catalogue.

fields.name: DepartmentCode
fields.notes: Must match the job code's department. Not written to Entra; Department is.

fields.name: CostCenter
fields.notes: Must match the department's cost centre.

fields.name: ManagerEmployeeId
fields.notes: Resolved to the manager's object. Empty only for the CEO.

fields.name: ManagerUPN
fields.notes: Convenience column for humans. The ID is authoritative.

fields.name: UsageLocation
fields.notes: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2. Required before any licence can be assigned.

fields.name: EndDate
fields.notes: Required for Contractor and Intern. Writing it needs User-LifeCycleInfo.ReadWrite.All.

derivedAttributes.name: AccountEnabled
derivedAttributes.rule: true if EmploymentStatus = Active and (EndDate empty or EndDate >= today); otherwise false
derivedAttributes.notes: Pre-hires are created disabled so Lifecycle Workflows can prepare them before day one.

derivedAttributes.name: IsPeopleManager
derivedAttributes.rule: 'PeopleManager' if at least one record has ManagerEmployeeId = this EmployeeId; otherwise 'IndividualContributor'
derivedAttributes.notes: Computed from the reporting lines, not from title or level. Drives manager-only access in Phase 03. Never empty: provisioning can't clear an attribute with an empty value, so a manager who stops managing would otherwise keep the old value.

dataQualityRules: See README.md, section 'Data quality rules'. Implemented in scripts/python/validate_hr_feed.py.
